manifest.description: Candidate passes only if ALL 14 gates are true (§12). No lookahead, strategy identity preserved, exposure within band.
criteria: 2. Full-period return no worse than CONTROL by >5 percentage points (candidate_total_return >= control_total_return - 0.05).
3. Worst contemporaneous single-position account loss improves >=20% OR p99 position-account loss improves >=20% (candidate_worst >= control_worst * 0.80 in absolute terms, i.e., less negative).
4. Top-5 loss concentration does not worsen materially (candidate top5 concentration <= control top5 + tolerance, not materially larger).
6. Median paired 20-fold return delta >= 0 (candidate - control per fold median).
7. >=10/20 Sharpe folds beat CONTROL (candidate Sharpe > control Sharpe in at least 10 folds).
9. Real 3x-cost run preserves Sharpe >= CONTROL 3x OR remains within 0.02 with materially better tail metrics.
10. No one-year dependency (every single calendar year + exclude windows not dominated; candidate not critically dependent on one year).
11. No single-symbol dependency (candidate-specific own top-3 jackknife still satisfies gates 1-3).
12. Average equity exposure must remain within CONTROL +/-5 percentage points unless reduced exposure itself produces sufficiently higher Sharpe.
13. No lookahead (P3 ES strictly through decision timestamp, verified by construction and test).
14. Strategy selection/ranking identity unchanged (P3 alpha RANKING and selected names identical to P0; only final target weights differ — parity test).

interpretation.P1_P2: P1/P2 change portfolio-risk geometry, do NOT create new alpha. If 8x7.5% succeeds interpret as diversification/risk-policy improvement not new alpha. If 7th/8th names destroy returns report plainly. Do NOT afterwards try 7.8%/8.0%/8.2%/9 positions — no post-result grid.
interpretation.P3: If P3 fails do NOT test ES5/ES15/90d/180d after seeing results. Conclude predeclared estimator did not add value. If P3 succeeds run parity tests proving alpha RANKING and selected names identical to P0 only final target weights differ.
interpretation.combinations: Do NOT run P2+P3 in this mission. First establish whether either idea works independently. No combinatorial search.
